figurative_meaning_en: liver; heart; vital force; innermost self
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জিগরে আগুন জ্বলে উঠল শত্রুদের কথা শুনে।
example_sentences_in_english: His heart burned with rage upon hearing about the enemies.
His innermost self was torn apart by his friend's betrayal.
history: Referenced in Kazi Nazrul Islam's poetry, where it symbolizes bravery and readiness to confront enemies, as in the line evoking a heart prepared to tear foes apart.
note: Influenced by Persian/Urdu origins, commonly used in Bengali to denote courage or deep emotion.
